northStar.title: Annual recurring revenue
northStar.question: Is recurring revenue growing fast enough to reach the goal?
northStar.definition: Annual recurring revenue in thousands of dollars, as published in the weekly company metrics report. The goal is $14.4M of ARR by 31 December 2027.
howCalculated: The latest weekly company metrics report published by the date (pages labelled «report»).
Its «ARR, $k» value: recurring revenue under signed client contracts, annualised, in thousands of dollars.
On track when the average weekly gain over the last four reports is at least the gain still needed each week to reach 14400 by Dec 31, 2027; watch at half of it.
